The combined graph-type separation and exact crown hierarchy require further analysis.

value.rationale: The exact quotient of a natural dense bipartite graph family by every fixed-variable theory makes the logical visibility of a full perfect-matching deletion sharp (invisible at width two, visible at three). The crown component yields explicit connected, high-degree graph witnesses for strictness of the noncounting width hierarchy at arbitrarily large width, with \(2(k-1)\) exact classes for the combined family and unique minimum representatives. This goes beyond the previously known biclique-only formula. No general downstream theorem is claimed.
